{{Top|leg}}
'''Hellic''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Hellic was able to ship a [[Taser stave|taser staff]] off [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], only to discover that the weapon was prone to damage when it was broken down into separate parts.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
